name: Computer Vision

seo.title: Computer Vision for Inspection and Safety | VipraTech
seo.description: Custom computer vision for quality inspection, safety compliance, damage assessment and shelf monitoring, using your cameras and photos.

hero.headline: Cameras and photos that flag what needs attention
hero.subheadline: We build vision systems for inspection, safety and verification that work with the cameras and phone photos you already have, and hand decisions to your supervisors.

intro: Vision projects fail when they chase a demo instead of an operational decision. We start from the decision a supervisor, assessor or inspector makes today, collect the images that matter, and build a model and review flow around that decision. Edge or cloud deployment is chosen for your sites, bandwidth and privacy needs.
what_we_build: Photo verification for field visits and surveys
Dashboards and alert routing to supervisors
how_we_work: Define the decision and the defect classes with your team
Collect and label images from your real conditions
Train and test on held-out sites or shifts
Deploy with a review loop that keeps improving the model

faqs.a: Often not. Many use cases work with existing CCTV or phone photos. If image quality limits accuracy, the pilot shows where a better camera position or lighting would help.
Both are possible. Sites with weak connectivity or strict privacy rules usually run on an edge device, with only alerts and samples sent to the cloud.

faqs.q: Does this replace our safety or QC staff?
faqs.a: No. It flags events and defects so supervisors spend time on the cases that need them. Statutory safety systems stay in place.
